motion.name: camera-travel
motion.value: 66 logical units/s while driving; 0 during settling, growth and emergence
motion.purpose: Road, foreground cities and parallax travel stop together on death.

motion.name: distant-parallax
motion.purpose: Lavender mountains, cities and atmospheric drift.

motion.name: middle-parallax
motion.purpose: Turquoise hills, cities and atmospheric drift.

motion.name: wheel-rotation
motion.purpose: Continuous round-tire rotation, including garage emergence.

motion.name: paired-fire
motion.value: 0.22s shared interval; maximum 3 airborne pairs; 320 logical units/s
motion.purpose: Straight fixed upward and forward rounds share burst slots until both disappear.

motion.name: rebirth
motion.value: 0.35s settled wait; 2.6s growth plus stagger; 0.5s shutter; 1.8s emergence
motion.purpose: Rested parts become towers and a compact garage; resume only after exit.

motion.name: pause
motion.value: Click / Space; focused Enter; reduced motion starts paused
motion.purpose: Freeze all simulation without drawing controls.

motion.name: triad-attack
motion.value: Base speed 34 logical units/s; hover amplitude 8, frequency 2.8; initial drop readiness 0.55 + slot × 0.24s; subsequent interval 1.1s; payload 4
motion.purpose: Fifth foreground UFO type bypasses the ordinary shared 2.8–4.4s bomb cooldown, while respecting the ahead-only requirement and shared maximum of 3 airborne bombs. Triad bombs start 14 units below the ship at vy 50; ordinary bombs start 8 below at vy 32. All bombs have vx 0 and gravity 48 logical units/s².

motion.name: ground-rhythm
motion.value: Five cyclic phrases: step-hop, rattle, double-hop, heavy, offbeat; 3–5 hazards each at fixed world offsets; 198–264 world-unit rest after last beat (3–4 driving seconds); first phrase after 0.6s
motion.purpose: Replace isolated random obstacles with authored hop rhythm. spawnGroundPattern(index = groundPattern++) adds each phrase as offscreen world objects together. Pattern timing pauses with the camera and retains post-garage grace.

motion.name: safe-jump-deceleration
motion.value: Mature planner may decelerate from a committed jump boost only after rehearsing the entire remaining flight and landing safely
motion.purpose: Allow a safe return toward rear cruise without changing acceleration 54, camera speed 66, preferred 19–28% position or 42% avoidance cap.

motion.name: automatic-hop
motion.value: Launch 157.5 logical units/s; gravity 294 logical units/s²; peak 42.19 units; level-ground airtime 1.071s
motion.purpose: Lower peak height by 30% from 60.27 units while preserving airtime. Predictive padding stays 6 normally and 7 during easing, capped at 2 only for rocks larger than 18 units; physical collision padding remains 0.

rendering.backingStore: round(innerWidth × min(2, devicePixelRatio || 1)) by round(innerHeight × min(2, devicePixelRatio || 1))
rendering.logicalSpace: min(480, innerWidth) by round(innerHeight × logicalWidth / innerWidth)
rendering.context: Display-to-logical transform; image smoothing enabled; round line caps and joins
rendering.pits: Fill the void without stroke, then stroke descending sides/bottom as an open path. Never stroke a closing cap across the mouth; retain physical collision/fill profiles.
rendering.depthOrder: Distant activity follows the mountains. Middle saucers, bombs and impact effects draw before the middle hill loop, allowing hill occlusion.
rendering.backgroundCities: Distant and middle monochrome stems use open stroked contours; foundations fill without strokes. No bottom baselines. Foreground foundation outlines are unchanged.
rendering.triad: Three colors.triad-body spheres with colors.orange cores and colors.ink links; 26 × 20 collision envelope, 4 hit points. The four classic saucer styles remain unchanged.
rendering.groundHazards: Low chips: 6–8 units, broken low angular rock profile, chip:true, hp1. Medium rocks: 11–14 units, hp1. Heavy rocks: 24 units, hp3. Authored pits: 24–32 units. Bomb-created craters unchanged.
rendering.mountains: Authored angular peaks and shoulders without sinusoidal ridge noise. One continuous silhouette fill and open skyline span matching 340-unit repeats without tile seams. Sparse connected summit/shoulder folds; no detached slash marks. Lavender palette, height limits, 0.18 parallax and cities remain unchanged.

colorDerivations.tires: Round each generation body sRGB channel × 0.55.
colorDerivations.foregroundTints: Interpolate sRGB channels toward colors.paper; foreground details only.
colorDerivations.ramps: Inspection-only synthesized OKLCH ramps; not additional scenery colors.
colorDerivations.roverGuns: Exact current generation body paint, including continuous flared roots; enemy turret barrels retain colors.pipe.

extensions.combatGroundTargets: Paired fire considers ground targets only ahead and within fixed forward barrel height. Chips below the barrel require hops. Shared paired trigger and maximum 3 airborne burst slots are unchanged.

narrative.overview:
A self-playing lunar patrol rendered as smooth ink contours and flat color. The approved illustrated world uses a spacious lavender sky, jagged lavender mountains, turquoise hills, whimsical alien architecture, classic saucers and a low three-wheel rover. This design system applies only to this piece.

Distance is organized by palette as well as overlap and motion. Mountains and distant buildings share one lavender family; hills and middle buildings share one turquoise family. Foreground wreckage grows into architecture that retains its source paint, making the crash and replacement cycle visible without a HUD.
keyCharacteristics: Smooth outlined procedural drawing at display resolution.
Two quiet, color-isolated background planes and an inherited-color foreground.
Flattened alien pods, substantial uneven stems, irregular apertures, balconies and framed bays.
Fixed paired fire, recognizable tumbling parts and a compact garage exit.
Full-viewport, text-free artwork with accessible pause and image export.

rules.name: The Layer Family Rule
rules.body: Keep distant terrain, buildings, saucers and decorative drops within the distant body/ink family, and middle scenery within the middle body/ink family. Do not borrow foreground accents for either plane.

rules.name: The Material Inheritance Rule
rules.body: Derive each tire channel by rounding the body sRGB channel multiplied by 0.55. Wheel fragments and their buildings retain that darker paint; other fragments and their buildings retain body paint.

rules.name: The Text-Free Rule
rules.body: Keep titles, instructions, counts and status outside the drawing. Use accessible names and machine-readable data for this information.

rules.name: The Flat Ink Rule
rules.body: Use flat fills and drawn contours; do not introduce gradients, glow or baked lighting.

dos: Do keep the distant and middle palette families isolated across terrain, cities and atmospheric activity.
Do preserve smooth ink contours, round rotating tires and recognizable rotating debris.
Do merge body-painted guns into the chassis while aligning openings with the actual fixed projectile origins.
Do preserve body and tire paint through wreckage and foreground city growth.
Do keep the compact garage clearance and the existing gameplay coordinate space.
donts: Don't restore the discarded black sky, saturated cyan/green landscape or pixelated rendering.
Don't add visible titles, scores, captions, labels, instructions or text controls.
Don't add gradients, glow, baked lighting or white rooftop crossbars.
Don't cap pit mouths with an ink line or give close buildings uniform eye rows and mouth curves.
Don't draw middle-layer UFO activity over the hills or add bottom baselines to distant or middle buildings.
Don't turn background cities into growing structures or atmospheric UFOs into combat targets.
Don't replace live procedural drawing with the approved still image.
